name: unit-tier-pure
body:
A unit test exercises EXACTLY ONE unit — a single function, method, or struct's behaviour — with everything else FAKED. Its collaborators (filesystem, database, git, process spawning, network, clock, environment) are replaced by in-memory fakes; the test performs NO real I/O. It is pure in-memory: it runs in-process, with no temp directory, no `db.lbug` open, no git invocation, and no process spawn.

AC: a unit test's body takes no real-I/O action (nothing matching the `global.constraint.test-tier-boundaries` boundary); every collaborator outside the one unit under test is a fake/stub/double; running the test creates and leaves no filesystem artifacts.
